notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Golgari Rot Farm and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.
